hello.text: Ah. A Waker. Are you sleeping well? No one does, at first...

choices.text: Does everyone come to in the dormitory?

dorm.text: Here? Here, yes. Elsewhere... Who told you to ask that? No. It doesn't matter. Not every Waker comes to in a bed, that's all. Some come to... somewhere else.

wisps.text: What are they? I've asked them. They don't answer. They come off the falls like breath on a cold morning... and every year there are more. Would you count them, if you were me?

dreamed.text: You've dreamed now. Has it come back? The water, the falling... the listening. You'd tell me if it did?

choices.text: Does everyone come to in the dormitory?

promise.text: Good. Good. The book has room. It always has room. That's what worries me.
